frontal hit, and the hood latch and both headlight assemblies are damaged. Crush
pattern and paint transfer line up with the reported collision, and no prior damage to
this vehicle is known or visible on the panels. The proposed repair plan replaces the
bumper cover, hood latch, and affected lamps, straightens the support, and refinishes
the front end. Labor hours are in line with the work described. Invoices submitted show

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
